Unified cross-module linkages between Organization, Accounting, Revenue, Expenses & Treasury
Ledger Pipeline: Chart of Accounts → Journal Entry → Journal Lines
Revenue Recognition: Service Sale → Revenue Transaction → Allocations
Receivables & Treasury: Invoice → Customer Payment → Cash/Bank Collection
Agency Settlements: Gross Share → Withholding Tax → Net Payable Payout
Expenses & Payables: Expense Voucher → Expense Account → Cash/Bank Outflow
Tax Ledger: Withheld Agency & Payroll Tax → Tax Payable → Remittance
Period Governance: Fiscal Period → Lock State → General Ledger Finality
